    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="ru">
    <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Характеристики</title>
    <style>
    :root{--bg:#000;--muted:rgba(255,255,255,0.58);--accent:#fff}
    html,body{height:100%;margin:0}
    body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--accent);font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;position:relative;overflow-x:hidden}
    body.tg-app{padding-top:120px}
    .tabs{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:9999;display:flex;gap:8px;padding:53px 14px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
    .page-shell{position:relative;transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .35s ease;will-change:opacity,transform}
    .page-shell.page-enter{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}
    .page-shell.page-exit{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-12px)}
    .background-svg{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1;overflow:hidden}
    .content{min-height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:110px 16px 88px}
    h1{text-align:center;margin:0;padding:20px 0;font-size:24px}
    .zone-switcher{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin:0 auto 6px;max-width:520px}
    .club-switcher{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin:0 auto 16px;max-width:520px;padding:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
    .zone-button{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:var(--accent);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;transition:background .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),border-color .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),color .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)}
    .club-button{border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:var(--accent);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;min-width:90px;transition:background .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),border-color .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),color .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),transform .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)}
    .zone-button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
    .club-button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);transform:translateY(-1px)}
    .zone-button.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
    .club-button.active{background:#fff;color:#000;border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
    .club-panel{
    display:block;
    opacity:0;
    visibility:hidden;
    max-height:0;
    overflow:hidden;
    transform:translateY(3px);
    transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .35s ease,visibility .35s ease;
    }
    .club-panel.active{
    opacity:1;
    visibility:visible;
    max-height:2500px;
    transform:translateY(0);
    transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .35s ease,visibility .35s ease,max-height 0s;
    }
    .spec-card{
    max-width:520px;
    margin:0 auto 0;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    border-radius:12px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    overflow:hidden;
    opacity:0;
    max-height:0;
    transform:translateY(4px);
    transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .3s ease;
    pointer-events:none;
    }
    .spec-card.active{
    opacity:1;
    max-height:2000px;
    transform:translateY(0);
    transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .3s ease,max-height 0s;
    pointer-events:auto;
    }
    .spec-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
    .spec-title{margin:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2}
    .spec-badge{flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:#000;padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
    .spec-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
    .spec-item{display:grid;gap:4px;min-height:52px;padding:10px 14px;background:#050505}
    .spec-label{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1}
    .spec-value{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
    @media (max-width:460px){
    .spec-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
    .spec-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    }
    .bottom-nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:9999;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));align-items:center;height:70px;padding:6px 8px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));box-sizing:border-box;background:#050505;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);pointer-events:auto}
    .bottom-nav *{pointer-events:auto}
    .nav-item{display:grid;grid-template-rows:28px 14px;gap:5px;justify-items:center;align-content:center;width:100%;height:54px;min-width:0;padding:0 2px;box-sizing:border-box;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:10px;line-height:1;transition:color .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),transform .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)}
    .nav-item:hover{color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-1px)}
    .nav-item:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.96)}
    .nav-item.active{color:var(--accent)}
    .nav-item svg{width:26px;height:26px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
    .nav-item span{display:block;width:100%;line-height:14px;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
    .custom-select{position:relative;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 16px;z-index:100}
    .select-trigger{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;padding:14px 18px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .3s ease,background .3s ease;box-sizing:border-box;user-select:none}
    .select-trigger:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
    .select-trigger.open{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
    .select-trigger .arrow{transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);line-height:1}
    .select-trigger.open .arrow{transform:rotate(180deg)}
    .select-menu{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 6px);left:0;right:0;background:rgba(10,10,10,.97);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:14px;padding:6px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(-8px) scale(.97);transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .3s ease,visibility .3s ease;backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);overflow:hidden}
    .select-menu.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
    .select-option{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease}
    .select-option:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff}
    .select-option.selected{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
    .select-option .check{opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s ease;color:#fff;font-size:14px}
    .select-option.selected .check{opacity:1}
    </style>
    <script src="https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js"></script>
    <script>
    if (window.Telegram && window.Telegram.WebApp) {
    document.body.classList.add('tg-app');
    }
    </script>
    </head>
    <body>
    <div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Клубы">
    </div>
    <svg class="background-svg" viewBox="0 0 450 800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">
    <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0a0a0a"/>
    <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#111111"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0d0d0d"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="redGlow" cx="50%" cy="30%" r="45%">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c0392b" stop-opacity="0.12"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0a0a0a" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bottomGlow" cx="50%" cy="90%" r="40%">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c0392b" stop-opacity="0.06"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0a0a0a" stop-opacity="0"/>
